For flying, I recommend a 10,000–20,000mAh USB-C power bank from Anker, INIU, or UGREEN. This range provides enough power for long flights while staying comfortably below the typical airline battery capacity limit.

The most important features are:

Under 100Wh: Generally permitted in carry-on baggage without airline approval.

USB-C PD charging: At least 20–30W for phones, or 45–65W for laptops.

Compact and lightweight: Especially useful when traveling with only a backpack.

Built-in USB-C cable: Convenient when charging at your seat.

Important: Power banks must go in carry-on baggage, not checked luggage. Some airlines also restrict using or charging them during flights, so check your airline's policy.
